description: This file defines the UserApiService class which implements user-related API operations such as delete account, submit user request, and register. It manages operation states and handles API calls with error handling.

classes.name: UserApiService
classes.description: Implements user API operations including delete account, submit request, and registration, with internal operation state management.

methods.name: deleteAccount
methods.description: Deletes a user account by user UUID, manages operation lock, and handles errors.

methods.name: submitUserRequest
methods.description: Submits a user request with specified type, manages operation lock, and handles errors.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new user with email, password, key parameters, and ephemeral flag, manages operation lock, and handles errors.

methods.name: lockOperation
methods.description: Locks an API operation to prevent concurrent execution.

methods.name: unlockOperation
methods.description: Unlocks an API operation after completion.
